grade: Crianças pequenas (4 anos a 5 anos e 11 meses)
subject: O eu, o outro e o nós
description_pt: Manifestar interesse e respeito por diferentes culturas e modos de vida.

components.description_pt: Expressar curiosidade sobre práticas culturais diferentes da própria
components.description_en: Express curiosity about cultural practices different from one's own
components.cc_component_description: Respond thoughtfully to perspectives that differ from one's own during discussion

components.description_pt: Demonstrar atitudes respeitosas diante de modos de vida e culturas diversas
components.description_en: Demonstrate respectful attitudes toward diverse ways of life and cultures
components.cc_component_description: Follow established rules for respectful and productive collaborative discussion

components.description_pt: Reconhecer que diferentes culturas possuem valores e tradições distintos
components.description_en: Recognize that different cultures have distinct values and traditions
components.cc_component_description: Compare the treatment of similar themes across stories or myths from different cultures

cc_matches.description: Follow rules for collegial discussions, set specific goals and deadlines, and define individual roles as needed.

Respond thoughtfully to diverse perspectives, summarize points of agreement and disagreement, and, when warranted, qualify or justify their own views and understanding and make new connections in light of the evidence and reasoning presented.

Compare and contrast the treatment of similar themes and topics (e.g., opposition of good and evil) and patterns of events (e.g., the quest) in stories, myths, and traditional literature from different cultures.
